documentation.content: Sign up with the Cerell ?ref= link. Referred users typically receive startup credit; the referrer earns a $35 one-time bounty after the account stays active and meets the minimum spend.

Cerell proxies https://mcp.vultr.com/mcp (read-only, public preview) via OAuth. Run connect vultr (no api_key), open the returned authUrl, approve access, then connect again. Docs: https://docs.vultr.com/reference/mcp-server/overview. Referral: one-time bounty up to $100 — $80 to the developer, 20% Cerell stake.
